headline: 3M India Q2 Net Profit Drops 17% on Weaker Rupee and Rising Costs
summary: 3M India reported a 17% decline in second-quarter net profit, pressured by a weaker rupee and rising input costs, causing its shares to tumble up to 11%.
why: 3M India is a subsidiary of the global manufacturing and technology conglomerate 3M, specializing in industrial, safety, and consumer products in the Indian market.

impacts.name: 3M India Ltd
impacts.why: Lower quarterly net profit and escalating input costs directly compress profit margins and negatively impact share valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A 17% drop in quarterly net profit driven by rising input costs and currency headwinds directly triggered a sharp decline in the company's share price.
